﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: cactoos 0.35 -> 0.55.0

## Context

Project `java-api` (by zold-io) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.cactoos:cactoos` from `0.35` to `0.55.0` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/zold-io/java-api/pull/101

## Your Task

The source code is in `/java-api`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the compilation errors and then fix them.

arguments.description: Run Maven compile to see errors

  <description>Zold Java API</description>
  <url>https://github.com/zold-io/java-api</url>
  <inceptionYear>2017</inceptionYear>
  <organization>
    <name>Zold</name>

    <dependency>

      <version>0.0.3</version>

      <artifactId>cactoos-matchers</artifactId>

      <scope>test</scope>

      <version>5.9.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>junit</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
      <version>4.13.2</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.hamcrest</groupId>
      <artifactId>hamcrest-core</artifactId>
      <version>1.3</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</project>

steps.message:
Now I have a clearer picture. The key changes in cactoos 0.55.0 are:

1. **LengthOf** - moved from `org.cactoos.iterable` to `org.cactoos.scalar`
2. **CollectionOf** - removed, use `org.cactoos.list.ListOf` instead
3. **RandomText** - renamed to `Randomized` in `org.cactoos.text`
4. **Filtered** - exists in `org.cactoos.iterable` and `org.cactoos.collection` only has Immutable/NoNulls
5. **CheckedScalar** - renamed to `Checked` in `org.cactoos.scalar`
6. **UncheckedScalar** - renamed to `Unchecked` in `org.cactoos.scalar`
7. **IoCheckedScalar** - renamed to `IoChecked` in `org.cactoos.scalar`
8. **SolidScalar** - renamed to `Solid` in `org.cactoos.scalar`
9. **StickyScalar** - renamed to `Sticky` in `org.cactoos.scalar`
10. **SplitText** - renamed to `Split` in `org.cactoos.text`
11. **JoinedText** - renamed to `Joined` in `org.cactoos.text`
12. **TrimmedText** - renamed to `Trimmed` in `org.cactoos.text`
